''See also: [[Sword Sage Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Sword]] [[Sage]], also known as the [[Sage of the Endless Sword]], was a legendary and powerful [[Archlord]] who practiced a unique [[sword]] [[Path]]. Originating from the barbaric lands beyond [[Sacred Valley]], he was an expert in both weapon proficiency and refining, possessing rare ingredients such as [[sacred beast]] bones and unique herbs. He was a master of the [[Endless Sword]] [[technique]], a [[Ruler technique]] that served as the foundation for his fighting style and allowed him to perform feats such as deflecting multiple simultaneous attacks or slicing through [[wind madra]]. His combat abilities were so advanced that he could potentially cut mountains in half or strike with the power to cleave a [[Dreadgod]]. Physically, he was described as a wiry man with messy hair and half-lidded eyes, often wearing tattered black robes; he also possessed six [[sword]]-arms extending from his back. As a teacher, The Sword{{!}}the Sword [[Sage]] was known for being cryptic and demanding rather than coddling his students. He hand-selected Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius as his [[disciple]], providing her with a specialized blade and training her in his [[Path]]. Although he was a peak [[Archlord]], there were indications he may have reached the [[Gold stage]] of [[advancement]]. The [[Sage]] eventually died after venturing into a dangerous [[boundary field]] or maze, an event that left his [[disciple]] to seek wisdom through his remaining memories and relics. His legacy includes a private [[void space]] filled with treasures, a [[sword codex]] containing the memories of thousands of artists, and his signature blade, which remains a highly coveted artifact.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Sword]] [[Sage]] was a wiry man characterized by messy hair and half-lidded eyes. His [[Remnant]] features six [[sword]]-arms on its back.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|He was a person who preferred working alone over being part of a team. He taught his [[disciple]] that the pursuit of perfection in the [[sacred arts]] is a lonely endeavor, instructing her to act without regret and show no mercy to enemies.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Sword]] [[Sage]] possessed a spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense and the power to cut a mountain in half even without using a [[sword]]. His [[Remnant]] utilizes his white [[sword]] and is composed entirely of [[sword]]-aspect [[madra]].}}
